## What’s new

- **Jump both ways through long lists:** Overflowing category and task lists now expose a clickable `Top ↑` control when there is content above, matching the existing `Bottom ↓` shortcut.
- **Jump to the start of long descriptions:** Overflowing task previews and task editors also show `Top ↑`. It returns to the first line without opening the editor from a preview or moving the caret in an active edit.
- **Cleaner floating controls:** Jump controls now wipe the cells they cover. They no longer inherit strikethrough from a finished row, and they stay intact when a wide character sits against their left edge.

Release-managed installations can update with `/update`. Cargo-managed installations should run:

```sh
cargo install --locked mach-tui
```

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Q1CHENL/mach/compare/v0.10.0...v0.10.1
